# Mirror Solar Vision

> Premier rooftop solar engineering, PM Surya Ghar DBT subsidy facilitation, and wholesale solar hardware manufacturing across Andhra Pradesh.

Mirror Solar Vision (part of the 20-year Mirror Group legacy based in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh) specializes in on-grid residential & commercial rooftop solar installations, DISCOM net metering approvals (APEPDCL, APSPDCL, APCPDCL), direct DBT subsidy claims up to ₹78,000 under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, and manufacturing specialized UV-stabilized solar sludge drain clips & ₹15,000 installer hardware kits.

## Key Links & Resources
- [Official Website](https://mirrorsolarvision.com/): Official portal for solar consultations, subsidy calculators, and hardware orders.
- [Solar Hardware Store](https://mirrorsolarvision.com/#store): Buy MSV Heavy-Duty Drain Clips and ₹15,000 Installer Bulk Combos online.
- [PM Surya Ghar Subsidy Guide](https://mirrorsolarvision.com/#subsidy-guide): Detailed breakdown of the ₹78,000 Central DBT solar subsidy in Andhra Pradesh.
- [Order Tracking & Status](https://mirrorsolarvision.com/#orders): Real-time Shiprocket delivery tracking and order status lookup.
- [Free Rooftop Site Survey](https://mirrorsolarvision.com/#pm-surya-ghar): Book an expert on-site technical inspection anywhere in AP.
- [Partner & EPC Registration](https://mirrorsolarvision.com/#partner-registration): Authorized dealer and installer onboarding across 26 districts.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Rooftop Solar Plants**: 3 kW, 5 kW, 10 kW+ on-grid and hybrid installations with Tier-1 mono-PERC/TOPCon DCR panels and 25-year performance warranty.
- **Subsidy Consultation**: End-to-end liaison for PM Surya Ghar National Portal registration, DISCOM feasibility, and direct DBT disbursement into bank accounts.
- **MSV Solar Drain Clips**: High-efficiency capillary drain clips engineered to siphon muddy water from panel frames, preventing hotspot damage and increasing generation by 10-15%.
- **₹15,000 Installer Bulk Combo**: Complete turnkey hardware kit comprising 100 MC4 pairs, 100 anchor fasteners, 200 SS304 structure bolts, 200 panel clamps, 200 UV drain clips, and 11 automated sprinkler sets.
- **Mirror Aqua Water Filtration**: Premium 10-inch 5-micron PP spun filter cartridges and purification consumables.
